messages:
Maya (Product): quick sync — want to align on Q2 approach for catalog lifecycle: onboarding gates, bench pass defs, version pin exceptions, and deprecation runway. propose a 'tiered onramp' + automatic fallback. thoughts? :eyes:
Alex (ENG): +1. we need concrete SLOs (latency, quality delta, cost). also clarify who owns rollback.
Jon (ML): from evals: recommend two gates — (1) benchmark quality on curated prompts (median embedding cosine >= 0.93) and (2) infra SLOs p50/p95 latency targets. canary policy: 5% traffic, 48h, automatic rollback if quality drops > 3% on canary set.
Vivian (CS): note from customers — they want pin exceptions to be at least 6 months and an explicit migration opt-in workflow. also exportable pinned list for billing/legal.
Srini (Platform): ops constraints: we can do tenant-tagged canaries and runtime routing. need a clear fallback policy in config to avoid OOM/latency storms. example routing snippet:
```json
{"routing": {"policy": "canary", "canary_pct": 5, "fallback_model": "pinned_v1"}}
```
Maya (Product): Jon — what's the minimal prompt set size for a representative bench?
Jon (ML): 200 prompts per vertical (QA, summarization, instruction). keep evals stratified by token length and failure mode. automated eval job would run on each candidate onboarding. bench-bot will post results.
bench-bot: run complete for candidate aurora-1.2-q -> embed_cosine_median: 0.935, qa_exact_match_delta: +1.3%, latency_p95: +42ms, token_cost: -11%. status: PASS (quality + infra within tolerance).
Alex (ENG): PASS is great but +42ms p95 matters for low-latency customers. can we add a latency mitigation plan (quantize profile, batch hinting)? also add a soft-traffic-shape: start at 1% warmup -> 5% -> 20% over 72h unless errors.
Vivian (CS): for enterprise customers we should offer a pin-exception SLA page: TTL options (6m/12m), migration assistance, and a 'rollforward' credit if migration causes regressions.
Maya (Product): decision items to lock before RFC: 1) bench thresholds (quality/latency/cost), 2) canary cadence and automatic rollback rules, 3) pin TTL minimum and exception policy, 4) deprecation notice window and migration incentives, 5) ops config template. I'll draft RFC and include the code snippet Srini posted.
Srini (Platform): FYI I added a new config field to the staging router: `canary_decay_seconds` so we can ramp traffic slower. will open PR for review. :shipit:
Jon (ML): I'll assemble the 600-prompt vertical matrix and a sample eval harness. posting link: https://internal/bench/runs/aurora-1.2-q
Alex (ENG): flagging: need a short-run canary playbook for oncall with rollback cmds: `redwood route set --tenant $T --model pinned_v1` and `redwood rollback --run $CANARY_ID`.
Vivian (CS): I'll draft customer comms for pin exceptions and migration credits. target customers first: finance & health.
Maya (Product): thanks team. next sync Fri 3pm to review RFC draft. please add blockers to the doc by EOD Thu. :calendar:
Alex (ENG): noted.
Jon (ML): will add eval thresholds.
bench-bot: scheduled nightly sanity run for candidate models at 02:00 UTC.
Vivian (CS): prepping a short FAQ for sales.
Maya (Product): perfect — closing for now.
